title: fix(pm): measure the runtime stderr noise floor in the dispatch-gates self-test
body:
Fixes #17765

## What was wrong

The self-test battery in `scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs` described a spawned child's stderr **stream** in two places while meaning what **this module** prints. Every such child inherits the run's `NODE_OPTIONS`, and under `--use-env-proxy` node writes two lines before any user code runs:

```
(node:NNN) [UNDICI-EHPA] Warning: EnvHttpProxyAgent is experimental, expect them to change at any time.
(Use `node --trace-warnings ...` to show where the warning was created)
```

That flag is not exotic: it is what `check-required-contexts.mjs --verify-required-set` prints as its own remedy, citing #9642. So a seat that follows one gate's advice is punished by another — and the punishing gate is one nobody runs casually, because this self-test runs past the container's ten-minute foreground cap.

Both assertions were true statements about a real property, and both reds were entirely spurious:

| case | assertion before |
|:--|:--|
| entry guard (the card's, at `:22373` on the merge base) | `(imported.stderr ?? '').trim() === ''` |
| end-to-end CLI banner (found by running the full self-test under the flag) | `(plainRun.stderr ?? '').split('\n')[0].includes('gate list derived from the tree of')` |

The second one is a **deviation from the dispatched file face**, declared here: it is the same defect class, in the same file, in the same gate family, and the card's own acceptance ("the self-test reaches its verdict with exit 0 under `--use-env-proxy`") is unreachable while it stands. No other file is touched.

## The fix — one measured floor, not a pattern

For each probe an identical child that does **nothing** runs with the same argv shape, cwd and inherited env. Whatever **it** prints is what this runtime prints unprompted; anything the probe prints beyond that came from the module. The single normalisation is node's pid, which differs between any two children by construction.

- `stderrBeyondRuntime(probe, baseline)` — what the probe wrote **beyond** the floor (the entry-guard case).
- `moduleStderrLines(probe, baseline)` — the probe's lines with an exact leading match of the floor removed, so a case can still speak about **which** line the module wrote first (the banner case).

Both live once, above the end-to-end CLI block, and both instances call them — one explanation and one subtraction in the file rather than two copies.

⛔ **Not a shape filter.** The `(Use ...)` hint line carries no `[CODE] Warning:` at all, so a filter written to node's warning shape leaves it behind — the case stays red — while swallowing a line the module wrote in that same shape. Triage measured this on the card: `grep -c "Warning:"` over that stderr answers 1, not 2.

⛔ **No shared helper across files, and `scripts/check-cross-package-test-inputs.mjs` is untouched** — that half is another domain's.

## Controls

Without controls, "prints nothing of its own" and "prints nothing that is ever looked at" are the same green. Four were added:

- NEGATIVE: importing a module that writes nothing is clean under THIS runtime.
- POSITIVE: one line the imported module writes to stderr still reds.
- POSITIVE: a line **disguised** as a node warning still reds — this is what separates a measured baseline from a shape filter, which would swallow it.
- CONTROL: the floor child writes no line of its own, so the banner subtraction cannot be answering an empty list.

## Acceptance readings

Direct-drive probe of each case's own consumer shape, flag as the only variable. `OLD` is the assertion on the merge base `400167ab`, `NEW` is the assertion on this head.

**Entry-guard case** — a child importing this module, argv `--self-test --tier packages/spec/src/index.ts`:

```
NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=4096
    status 0, stdout CONSUMER-REACHED, probe stderr ""      OLD true   NEW true
NODE_OPTIONS=--use-env-proxy --max-old-space-size=4096
    status 0, stdout CONSUMER-REACHED
    probe    stderr: (node:30022) [UNDICI-EHPA] Warning: ... + hint line
    baseline stderr: (node:30030) [UNDICI-EHPA] Warning: ... + hint line
    beyond-runtime text: ""                                 OLD false  NEW true
```

**Banner case** — the real CLI child, argv `--tier packages/spec/src/index.ts`:

```
NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=4096
    baseline stderr lines: []                               OLD true   NEW true
NODE_OPTIONS=--use-env-proxy --max-old-space-size=4096
    baseline stderr lines: 2 (the UNDICI-EHPA warning + the hint line)
    module first line: "dispatch-gates: gate list derived from the tree of ..."
    control: floor-vs-floor 0 lines, probe 7 lines          OLD false  NEW true
```

**Full self-test, detached** — `pnpm check:pm-dispatch-gates` runs past the ten-minute foreground cap, so it is run detached and polled to its verdict line. No full run was taken on the merge base (the merge-base readings above are the direct-drive probes). The run taken with the entry-guard repair alone, at `e53c83c3` under `--use-env-proxy`, ended:

```
  ✗ and it opens with the banner, on the FIRST line of stderr
✗ dispatch-gates self-test: 1 of 1681 case(s) failed.
```

which is how the second instance was found. On this head under the same flag:

```
  ✓ and it opens with the banner, on the FIRST stderr line THIS module writes
  ✓ CONTROL: the floor child writes no stderr line of its own — the subtraction above cannot be vacuous
  ✓ imported, this module prints nothing of its own on either stream
  ✓ NEGATIVE CONTROL: importing a module that writes nothing is clean under THIS runtime
  ✓ POSITIVE CONTROL: one line the imported module writes to stderr still reds
  ✓ POSITIVE CONTROL: an imported line DISGUISED as a node warning still reds
✓ dispatch-gates self-test: 1682 cases pass.
```

`pnpm check:pm-dispatch-gates` exit **0** at `12a89168` (merged with `origin/main` `45b90b6a`), under `NODE_OPTIONS=--use-env-proxy --max-old-space-size=4096`. Case count 1682 = the 1678 the card measured, plus the four controls this PR adds.

## Gates

Derived with `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` (no paths; change set taken from git, 1 path, against merge base `45b90b6a9`). The first derivation was taken on a stale tree and warned so; `origin/main` was merged in and the list re-derived on `12a89168` — identical, 31 commands. All 31 run, every exit code recorded, reconciled:

```
✓ dispatch-gates --ran: 31 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 31 run,
  0 NOT-MEASURED (a DERIVED zero — all 31 recorded an exit code and none of them is 3).
```

Outside that link, and not claimed here: the 52 artifact-roster families, the 11 wide-population families, the 14 pending-changeset families (none apply — this PR carries no changeset by design), the path-scheduled CI job and the always-runs tail. Repo-wide `pnpm lint` is CI's run, not this one.

## Acceptance notes

- **Should the two files share one helper?** The card asks this and triage adopted it as a must-answer. Measured answer: **not yet.** The population of "literally empty child stderr" assertions in the repo is exactly two — this file and the sibling — and a `git grep` over `scripts/**` finds no third: every other child-stderr assertion there is a targeted `.includes()` on content the child itself wrote, which runtime noise cannot falsify. The part that could be shared is four lines of pure text subtraction; the part that must **not** be shared is the spawn, whose argv shape has to match each file's real probe by construction. A cross-file import would also add an edge into this tool's own derivation, whose module-body literals are inherited as watch hints by anything importing it. The trigger that changes the answer is a third copy; filing that is for whoever meets one.
- Noted, not filed: nothing else. Successor for the shared-helper question if a third instance appears: the `domain:devx` seat that owns `scripts/check-cross-package-test-inputs.mjs`.
- `skip-changeset`: `scripts/pm/**` ships in no package's `files[]`, so this diff publishes nothing.
- Hold #14290 declares `Restart-touch: scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs`; its re-measurement after this lands is the devx seat's, not this PR's. #17797 names this file on the docblock-prose face and is untouched here.
